title: Mixed Event — Hear Me! Hopeful Show♪ — Episode8 Becoming a Four-Leaf Clover

meta.Event Outline: MORE MORE JUMP! continue their livestreams, but Minori is plagued with unease as she fails to find acceptance from the group's fans. One day, an opportunity arises for a collaboration with a famous former idol turned streamer...

rows.Line: The day of the livestream
A small live house

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
W-Whoa...!
We're performing here?!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: It isn't big and glamorous, but it's nice, right?

rows.Speaker: Staff A
rows.Line: Let's do a camera test!

rows.Speaker: Staff B
rows.Line:
We have a good feed.
Whenever you're ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow! Such a big staff team too...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yeah, they're from the agency. They all helped us reserve venues and assist with streams for events and stuff!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
The agency...?
Hayakawa, you're in an agency?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: I am, but they're a little different from an entertainment agency. They work with a lot of people who primarily make online content!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: To be honest, it's too much work for one person to put on an event. They've been so helpful, and I can even make new music thanks to them too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I see. I didn't realize that was an option too...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: So feel free to ask me anything. I'll gladly help you out if you ever need me to!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Thank you, we will...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hehe! Now, let's rehearse our show!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Singing with Miku in SEKAI is one thing, but I'll be on a real stage for the first time...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: I never thought we'd be able to put on a show so soon. I prepared myself for a much longer wait.

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Haruka...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Yes, and even though there's no one here right now, I hope we'll fill a venue with lots of people someday...

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: What are you talking about? They might not be here, but there's a ton of people on the other side of those cameras!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: They wouldn't all be able to fit into this place!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh, right...! Nanamin's channel has 800,000 subscribers!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Right.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So let's use those cameras to give them hope for a better tomorrow!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah...!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Hi! Thanks for tuning in, everyone!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Finally!!>
<Showtime?>
<Yes!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Whoa, so many people are watching today too!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<You can do it, Haruka!>
<Airi! I'm rooting for you!>
<Hurry up and let Shizuku sing!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Don't screw up like last time, Minori.>
<You did practice for this, right?>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (No, don't let them get you down! I practiced so hard for this! I'll be fine...!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Just wait! The four of us are gonna give you something you'll never forget!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: So stay tuned until the end!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Alright, let's get this show on the road!!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
I-It really is her!
Nanamin from CreamBerry!
She's so amazing!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: She really matured since then, but we gotta show them what we're made of too...!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line:
It's almost time.
Ready, everyone?

rows.Speaker: Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: Ready!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Yeah!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Delivering them hope as MORE MORE JUMP!)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's do this!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: More and more songs!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: More and more energy!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: More and more hope!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: More and more and more for everyone!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: MORE MORE...

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka & Airi & Shizuku
rows.Line: JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Thanks for tuning in, everyone! All your comments are making our show just that much more fun!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Next, let's give it up for MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line:
Everyone!
This show's just getting started!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: So I hope you'll hear our song too.

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Let's go!

rows.Speaker: Minori & Haruka
rows.Line: Start the music!
song00004_off_f

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Whoa! All three on the same stage...!>
<Harukaaa!>
<So cuuute!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Whoa...! I'm literally in the spotlight...! It's like I'm dreaming...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Oh no, now that I'm thinking about it, I'm getting a little nervous...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Is Minori okay?>
<Just don't mess up...>

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Yes! I'm a huge fan of yours, and I wish I could be just like you...!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: But I can't do what you do, Minori...

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Minori, you can do it!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm sure that person is watching too. This show has to succeed in order for me to give them any hope!)

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: (Minori's doing really well!)

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line:
(Minori's solo is coming up...!
I believe that she can...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I will succeed!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Here comes Minori!>
<She gets her own solo?>
<Really?!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Please...!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Please, reach them...!)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<She feels like an idol now.>
<Oh, she's good!>
<MORE MORE JUMP! is the best!>

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Minori really is amazing...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (She's doing so much better here than during practice. And she's really reaching everyone through those cameras...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (Her passion for giving hope is making her radiate with it...)

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: (I'm sure of it, Minori. You're going to blossom into something incredible.)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: *Huff*... *Huff*...

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: Everyone, thanks for staying until the end!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: We hope you enjoyed our first show as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We were a little nervous at first, but we're glad that we could give you this performance.

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<That was awesome!>
<First-time viewer to fan!>
<I'll start watching your videos!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Shizuku's the best!>
<I get to see Haruka as an idol again...>
<You did great, Airi!>

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Minori was pretty good.>
<A lot better than before.>
<She really can do it!>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Wow...

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line:
You guys, that was incredible!
And your solo was off the hook, Minori!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Th-Thank you!

rows.Speaker: Haruka
rows.Line: And thank you, Nanamin. We were able to take a big step forward as MORE MORE JUMP!

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: We'd love to do another join stream with you as well.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: No, we have to have her as a guest on our stream next time!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Yeah! That sounds great!

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: But that should be it for today's...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: W-Wait! I'd like to say something as well...!

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: Minori?

rows.Speaker: Nanamin
rows.Line: Of course! The floor's all yours!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Thank you! Um...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: I'm still just starting out as an idol, I may still end up holding back my friends a little and make them worry...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: But...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Even someone like me was able to stand up here and put on a show! We all took a big step forward!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
So it's okay!
This means you can do it too!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: If I can do it, so can you! Let's keep trying, together!

rows.Speaker: Minori's fan
rows.Line: Minori...

rows.Speaker: Shizuku
rows.Line: Hehe. What a wonderful speech.

rows.Speaker: Airi
rows.Line: That was pretty nice!

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line:
<Minori's legit.>
<I think I like her now...>
<That speech felt so real.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Hehehe...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (And I hope I reached that person too...)

rows.Speaker: Comment
rows.Line: <Minori, thank you. I'll give it another shot and try my best.>

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: Oh...

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (Thank goodness... I did reach them...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (I'm still nowhere near the idol that Haruka and the others are...)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (But as long as I can reach even just one person! As long as I can reach the fans in front of me, I can keep going...!

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line: (As long as I keep doing that, I'll become an idol that can deliver hope!)

rows.Speaker: Minori
rows.Line:
Yeah, just keep trying!
More and more and more!
